newsitem.title: USA: Some key US meat packers to observe Easter holiday.
newsitem.headline: Some key US meat packers to observe Easter holiday.

text.p: Some major U.S. pork and beef packing companies will adjust operating hours to observe the Easter holiday either Friday or Monday while others said schedules will be unchanged by the holiday.

ConAgra Inc spokeswoman, K.T. Miller, said the company's Worthington, Minn., Swift and Co hog plant would be closed on Monday, while Swift's two other pork plants in Iowa and Kentucky would remain open.
Miller said she had no immediate information regarding operating hours at ConAgra's three Monfort-unit beef plants.
IBP Inc spokesman Gary Mickelson said none of IBP's seven pork plants or 11 beef plants will be adjusting hours for the holiday.
Excel Corp, a division of Cargill Inc, will operate regular schedules Friday and Monday at all of its six beef and three pork plants, said Mark Klein, Excel spokesman.

Farmland Industries' four hog and pork plants will operate a normal schedule Friday, and two will operate Saturday, a company source said. All four plants will be closed Monday. The plants are in Crete, Neb.; Denison, Iowa; Dubuque, Iowa; and Monmouth, Ill.
